answers.reason: The dean leads a faculty and does not hold a seat in the central senate.
The budget planning round is handled by the university leadership and chancellor, not faculty deans.
The examination board handles individual student matters, which is separate from the dean's faculty leadership duties.
Module revision is handled by a specific working group rather than the faculty dean.
Laboratory equipment procurement is a distinct body handling one delimited kind of question outside the dean's specific body.
The dean leads one faculty and chairs its council.
The study commission is a separate body advising the faculty council rather than chaired by the dean.
Internal research funding is handled by its own funding round body, not the dean.
Orientation week planning is a separate working round, not part of the dean's specific body.
Appointment committees select candidates for vacant professorships as a separate body.
